SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter, min(calendar_date) AS d0, max(calendar_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT fiscal_week) AS weeks, min(fiscal_week) AS w0, max(fiscal_week) AS w1
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_rl, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL AS no_dispatch, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS n_orders, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code = 'WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2026-02-05'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_year AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM by_year ty JOIN by_year ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region

SELECT d.fiscal_year, sum(r.net_sales) AS control_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS control_gross, sum(r.returns_net) AS control_returns, count(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS stores
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND (s.store_id = 999 OR p.category = 'ZZ Test')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
